newsitem.title: USA: AMEX says will trade 1/16th of a dollar increments. [CORRECTED 21:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: AMEX says will trade 1/16th of a dollar increments. [CORRECTED 21:45 GMT]

text.p: The American Stock Exchange said Monday it will begin trading in minimum increments of 1/16th of a dollar, or $0.0625 (corrects from $0.625), for all the stocks listed on the exchange from Wednesday.
AMEX said it is the first U.S. stock exchange to adopt the lower minimum trading increments, down from 1/8th, or $0.125.

AMEX said stock priced below $10 have been eligible to be quoted and traded in 1/16ths. AMEX said the announcement comes on the heels of the approval by the Securities and Exchange Commission of its proposal to begin trading in 1/16ths, which was submitted to the SECin mid-March.
